posts.cooked: What is a good drawing program for tablets, iPad and surface pro.

posts.name: Sejixs
posts.cooked:
tarsonas:

What is a good drawing program for tablets, iPad and surface pro. 

I'm sorry, but I have no idea. I always thought you had to buy them with the program already on it. Maybe one of the other forumites will know.

I personally just hand draw the outlines of the art pieces, scan them in, and photoshop the color. This is also probably why it takes me so long to post something.

posts.name: Adam
posts.cooked: I would recommend Manga Studio and Sketchbook Pro, both of which are on the cheaper end of illustration software. Also ArtRage for mimicking traditional media. With the Surface, it works flawlessly once you install the Wacom tablet driver, and I'd recommend a Wacom stylus for it as well. For iPad, Sketchbook and ArtRage as well, and Wacom also makes a stylus supported on iPad. However, don't expect as good of results from the iPad. It's not pressure sensitive, and even programming the brushes to simulate it only goes so far. Hope that helps! :)
